description: Returns a saved model's contents in the shape the compute tools take: a cap table's events and options, a waterfall's model and saved exit, or a fund's inputs, the features switched on, and featuresSavedButOff (configured but switched off). Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder) or "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model).

name: get_saved_model
title: Open a saved model
